//: rbh-hedge-var Phase 1 config. Live execution is gated OFF by design.

variational.//phase2_auth: Order gateway uses the token scheme: a browser-session token (VARIATIONAL_TOKEN) sent as the vr-token COOKIE (verified in vo — NOT Authorization: Bearer, which returns 'No token'). Endpoint paths are the review4 defaults (/api/quotes/indicative, /api/orders/new/market, /api/positions, /api/portfolio) — do NOT re-pin a `paths` override unless the real API moves. Variational's official Trading API is not yet public, so token+frontend endpoints are the only working route. NOTE: vr-token is a session cookie that expires — refresh from browser DevTools (Application -> Cookies -> vr-token) when reconcile 401s.

lighter.//phase2_signer: SignerClient reads LIGHTER_API_KEY_PRIVATE_KEY / LIGHTER_API_KEY_INDEX / LIGHTER_ACCOUNT_INDEX from account_env_file. Requires `pip install lighter-python` on the live host.

//funding_unit: Explicit per-venue funding unit (P1-2). Variational publishes an ANNUALIZED rate; RHC Lighter a per-interval decimal. The magnitude heuristic is now only a mismatch warning, not the source of truth.
//direction: auto = pick side from funding-spread sign each tick (agreed).
//funding_guard: Hard gate: both legs must publish a positive funding_interval_s. Verified live: Variational settles 4h (14400s, annualized rate); RHC Lighter is hourly but does NOT publish the interval field, so it stays UNVERIFIED until private settlement confirms it in Phase 2.
//entry: Signals are computed in hourly-normalized funding units.
//exit: Exit is trigger-based, never a timer.
//cost: Round-trip cost model for the break-even projection (measure live before trusting).
//live_fill_confirm: review4 P0-A: a leg is proven FILLED only by polling the venue signed position vs a pre-trade baseline. Timeout/poll for that confirmation loop.
//live_reconcile: review4 P0-C/P1-1: IDLE flat-check cadence (every N ticks while live) and how many CONSECUTIVE reconcile failures before a HOLDING round forces a protective exit.
//funding_attestation: review4 P0-D: verify-funding proves Lighter's hourly cadence from real settlements and writes a time-boxed attestation. Validity default 7d; cadence tolerance 20%; needs >= min_samples settlements.
//risk: Single-leg exposure watchdog + drawdown circuit breaker. max_round_loss_usdt is measured RELATIVE to the open baseline (sunk roundtrip cost excluded). max_daily_loss floor sits above the ~$24 roundtrip cost so a normal round cannot trip it (review3).
//alerts: Telegram alerts for HALT / single-leg / sustained data failure (P0-4). No-op when creds absent. Keys TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in env_file.
